summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of redesigned Enterprise C2C Staffing Lead Platform Business Portal. All 8 business routes tested successfully. Login, navigation, UI components, modals, filters, and all interactive elements working correctly. Dark/light mode toggle works on login page but has visibility issue on dashboard header.

ui_bugs.issue: Theme toggle button in dashboard header is not visible (hidden lg:flex class issue). Works correctly on login page.

issues: Minor React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - cosmetic issue, doesn't affect functionality

action_items: Consider making theme toggle more visible in dashboard header (optional - works on login page)
critical_code_review_comments: All 8 business pages are well-implemented with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Mock data is comprehensive and covers all use cases for staffing consultancy workflow
All navigation links work correctly with 8 sidebar items
All modals (candidate profile, add candidate, send candidates, send profile, add team member) open and close correctly
Filters, search, and view toggles work as expected
Per-candidate analytics and outreach filtering works correctly
seed_data_creation: N/A - All data is mocked via mockData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 business routes tested and working: /business/dashboard, /business/leads, /business/candidates, /business/recruiters, /business/outreach, /business/analytics, /business/team, /business/settings. Login via clicking 'Business Portal' demo credential then 'Sign In'. All UI components have data-testid attributes. Theme toggle works on login page but not visible on dashboard header.

features_tested.login_flow: PASS - Demo credentials fill form, login redirects to dashboard
features_tested.business_dashboard: PASS - 4 KPI blocks (Total Candidates, Active Submissions, Placements, Scraped Jobs), activity feed, candidate list, scraped jobs summary
features_tested.job_leads_explorer: PASS - Table and Grid view toggle both work, filter sidebar with checkboxes (engagement type, work mode, date posted), multi-job selection via checkboxes, 'Send Candidates' modal with candidate selection
features_tested.candidate_management: PASS - Grouped by bench recruiter (Amy Roberts, James Liu, Nina Patel), collapsible groups, click candidate row opens full profile modal with stats/contact/skills/education/certifications/resume/outreach history, Edit toggle makes fields editable, Add Candidate button opens form modal with all fields
features_tested.recruiter_directory: PASS - Simple contact directory table with phone/email/linkedin icons, Send Profile button opens modal to select candidate
features_tested.outreach_tracking: PASS - Stats (Total Sent, Candidates Active, This Week, Avg per Candidate), per-candidate filter dropdown, email tracking table showing candidate/job/recruiter/date/status
features_tested.analytics: PASS - Per-candidate filter dropdown, KPI cards (Candidates, Total Submissions, Interviews, Placements, Placement Rate), submission bar chart, conversion funnel, market insights (top skills, top locations)
features_tested.team_management: PASS - Team cards grouped by role (Bench Sales Recruiter, Senior Recruiter, Business Development, Sales Lead, Account Manager), shows assigned candidates under bench recruiters, Add Member modal
features_tested.settings: PASS - Company profile form, notification toggles, billing plan info (Enterprise $299/mo), integrations list (Gmail/Outlook, LinkedIn Recruiter, Slack connected)
features_tested.sidebar_navigation: PASS - 8 items: Dashboard, Job Leads, Candidates, Recruiters, Outreach, Analytics, Team, Settings
features_tested.dark_light_mode: PARTIAL - Theme toggle works on login page, not visible on dashboard header

mocked_api_note: 100% MOCKED - This is a UI-only project. All data comes from /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js. No backend API exists.
